newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Two electrocuted, six injured in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Two electrocuted, six injured in Philippines.

text.p: Two people were electrocuted and six others suffered serious burns on Saturday when a power transformer exploded beside their house in Angeles city, near Manila, police said.
The victims were electrocuted by a live wire which released 13,800 volts of electric power onto the roof of the house following the explosion, police said.
Police said the transformer could have exploded because of a power overload.
